Name: New Flower Dance Suit
Author: MarKsuu
Description:
[center][/center][left]This small mod changes the sprites of the Flower Dance suit.
The bowlegs have been removed, the suit is open showing a black shirt and the shoes are changed to darker ones.

This mod is using edited sprites of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110153923]kelly2892[/url]﻿'s mod.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
You first need to install these mods :
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8107]Flower Dancing - A Flower Dance Mod[/url]﻿

[i](the latest version is recommended for all these mods)
[/i]
[size=5]Installation[/size]
- First download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8107]Flower Dancing - A Flower Dance Mod[/url] and install it in the Mods folder.
- Download any suit you wish.
- Extract the files within the .zip into [b]\Mods\[CP] Kelly's Flower Dance Attire
[/b]- Accept to overwrite the files, and you're ready to enjoy your new suit!

You can request a new shirt color, I'll do it whenever I have the time.

[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
- Download the original mod and extract it to your mod folder.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
- It should work with every other mod as long they doesn't edit the farmer or the event.

[size=5]Credits[/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110153923]kelly2892[/url]﻿ for the original mod and his permission to do this mod.[/left]
